name: Epipolar 3D Gaussian Splatting
definition: A method that incorporates an epipolar transformer to generalize features between two views, pairing this with a probabilistic prediction of Gaussians aligned along camera-to-pixel rays.
summary: Epipolar 3D Gaussian Splatting uses an epipolar transformer to generalize features between views and probabilistically predict Gaussians aligned along camera-to-pixel rays.
